PZZ700-102215-
210 AM PDT Sat Oct 10 2026

.Synopsis for the far Southern CA coast...At 2 AM, a 1029 mb high
was about 900 nautical miles west of Washington State and a 999 
mb low was near Needles California. Tropical Storm Rachel was 
about 520 nautical miles southwest of San Diego with a central 
pressure of 992 mb. Weak northwest winds will prevail through 
today. The remnants of Rachel will bring an increase in southerly 
swell leading to choppy, combined seas up to 10 feet through 
Sunday, along with strong and gusty north northwest winds 20 to 30
knots early Sunday morning turning westerly through the 
afternoon. Winds and seas subside through Monday. More typical 
onshore flow returns by Tuesday.

$$
